name: Yellowish bronze
lede: Yellowish bronze is ColorHub's English name for Akakuchiba, a traditional Japanese color meaning "red fallen leaves."

sections.title: Red fallen leaves
sections.body:
The Japanese name 赤朽葉 (Akakuchiba) literally means red fallen leaves, one of a family of "kuchiba" fallen-leaf colors that also includes the paler [[yellowish-camel]] [1]. Our sources carry no date for when the name entered use; traditional Japanese color names are typically centuries old but undated here [1].

The nearest look-alike in our archive is [[raw-sienna]], 2.7 units away, almost the same; [[orpiment-orange]] follows at 2.8 [2]. [[mars]], 4.3 units off, is almost the same again but drifts toward brown [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: This color appears in 0.8 percent of our 23,781 paintings, 191 of them as photographed, more common than 66 percent of the names we track [3]. It peaks in the 1500s, found in 1.4 percent of the 2,231 paintings we have from then, 31 of them, 1.8 times the expected rate [3]. Inside a painting it plays an accent 80 percent of the time [3]. It is most over-represented in paintings from India, at 2.8 times the expected rate [3].
